checks.name: reviewed scalar mass versus norm-square
checks.detail: Read SupplementalHSecondTubes and EdgeFourthBounds: unweighted angle mass uses R²; the normal-square weighted term uses R⁴ separately. Angle≤pi/2 times chord cancels the true thin rectangle scale without an inverse-gap loss.

checks.name: reviewed Gaussian normalization
checks.detail: Read Fiber: orthonormal bisector/difference coordinates, exact Gaussian density factor d=(sqrt(2pi))^-2, physical radius correspondence and actual rectangle normalization are retained.

checks.name: reviewed conditional hard faces
checks.detail: Read Transport: closed inactive faces become strict under genuine ordinary residual slack; pair conditional Gaussian Fubini is justified by actual L1. No whole-family independence or hypothetical identity is assumed.

checks.name: reviewed finite ordered sum
checks.detail: Read Sum: diagonal and parallel cases are zero; actual nearest-base stratum geometry pays at most two ordered representations. This is independent of family size and handles empty low-dimensional pair families.

checks.name: reviewed native final hypotheses
